page.title: The Collections
page.description: Four curated expressions of fluid resin alchemy and natural timber, conceived for architectural spaces and private collectors.

values.title: Fallen Timber Only
values.body: We source felled logs and centuries-old stock from managed forests, honoring the organic morphology of each species.

values.title: 30-Day Slow Curing
values.body: Deep-pour bio-resin undergoes temperature-stabilized curing for both bubble-free clarity and long-term stability.

values.title: Atelier Certificate
values.body: Every artwork ships accompanied by an archival steel plate certificate inscribed with a serial number, atelier signature, and provenance.

page.ctaTitle: Envisioning a custom dimension or proprietary pigment vein?
page.ctaDescription: Our principal artist and wood technicians collaborate directly with interior designers, architects, and private clients. Send your spatial sketches, paint swatches, or timber preferences for immediate consultation.

dining-river-tables.title: River Dining Tables & Centerpieces
dining-river-tables.description: Statement dining and conference tables handcrafted with sustainably sourced live-edge olive wood, French walnut, and translucent epoxy rivers that capture ambient interior light.

specs.label: Base Architecture
specs.value: Blackened steel, raw brass, marble-thin wood

serving-trays-boards.title: Artisan Serving Trays & Charcuterie Boards
serving-trays-boards.description: Functional culinary art featuring mesmerizing fluid swirls of gold, emerald, and midnight black paired with rich natural timber. Every piece functions as heirloom serving board or tabletop sculpture.

wall-art-geodes.title: Geode & Celestial Resin Wall Panels
wall-art-geodes.description: High-gloss resin wall art infused with semi-precious quartz crystals, metallic pigments, and shimmering gold dust. Calibrated to interact dynamically with direct sunlight and interior gallery spans.

specs.label: Material & Minerals
specs.value: Smoky quartz, mica flakes, 24k gold leaf

home-bar-accents.title: Bespoke Home & Bar Decor Accents
home-bar-accents.description: Refined lifestyle accessories including raw-edge coaster sets, sculptural vessels, sommelier wine caddies, and organizers cast with subtle amber and black gold veils.

specs.label: Base Protection
specs.value: Pure Spanish merino wool felt backing
